subject.title: [Bug]: delivery-recovery 0 recovered / N failed after gateway restart — recovery starts before channel transport ready

question: Should Feishu recovery use a channel-owned reconnect/readiness drain, a startup readiness gate, or a retry-policy-only change for pending deliveries after gateway restart?
rationale: Source shows the remaining bug crosses gateway startup recovery, plugin channel readiness, and retry semantics, and the reporter's fixed-sleep/retry-reset workaround is too broad to choose automatically.

options.title: Feishu reconnect/readiness drain
options.body: Implement a Feishu-owned drain when WebSocket ready/reconnected status is observed, optionally coordinating with startup recovery, and require live Feishu restart proof.

options.title: Startup readiness gate
options.body: Gate generic startup delivery recovery on channel health, accepting broader cross-channel behavior changes that need wider regression proof.

options.title: Retry-policy-only follow-up
options.body: Cap or reset retry counts only after live proof shows readiness is not the right boundary, accepting weaker delivery-timing recovery.

recommendation.title: Feishu reconnect/readiness drain
recommendation.body: Implement a Feishu-owned drain when WebSocket ready/reconnected status is observed, optionally coordinating with startup recovery, and require live Feishu restart proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the gateway/outbound recovery boundary and Feishu transport split where their history is strongest, with m1heng as a Feishu-specific reviewer signal.
